text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Start of withdrawal of Israeli military equipment from Hebron after 30 years of occupation. Mubarak and Clinton discuss by telephone guarantees for implementing Hebron deal.
- Telephone conversation between Mubarak and Assad; Syrian Foreign Minister al-Shara to arrive in Cairo today.
- Head of Congress delegation says after meeting president that Mubarak is an international leader and that he looks forward to his next visit to Washington.
- Prime Minister opens book fair tomorrow.
- Mubarak to visit tourism projects in Gulf of Aqaba at the start of February; 65 projects worth 6 billion pounds on the Egyptian riviera.
- Standard and Poor's report is testament to the success of Egypt's economic policies.
- Finance Ministry official says price of many products to be reduced by end of January.
- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid says government spent 330 million pounds to save public from electrical bill price increases.
- Head of Investment Authority says government wants to give new incentives and ease regulations for investors, especially in New Delta and Wadi el-Nil.
